Maya (CSM): FYI — AcmeRetail renewal in 22d, weekly usage down 40% over last 7d. Triggered health alert. Proposing a 'Conserver' keepalive play to avoid churn: targeted enablement + usage credits + downgrade-smoothing + feedback capture. Quick thoughts?

cs-bot: Health alert: account=AcmeRetail severity=medium usage_drop=40% renewal_days=22

Ethan (CS Ops): +1. Can we scope a 14-day micro-engagement? 2x live office hours + check-ins. Metric to move: DAU -> 20% uptick.

Priya (Enablement): I can own the workshop. Proposed agenda: 1) Quick wins (dashboards, embeddings reuse) 2) Cost-controls (batching, cache) 3) Migration recipes. Need account sample queries and permission to run an audit.

Maya (CSM): I can share logs and top 5 failing prompts. Will also ask for an exec call next week.

Jasper (RevOps): If we offer credits, limit to 1 month and tie to usage targets. Also prepare a downgrade-smoothing concession: keep API keys + read-only dashboard after downgrade for 60d.

Nora (PM): We should capture why they're slipping. Suggest short survey + NPS capture. Draft email snippet:
```
Subject: Quick check — how can we help AcmeRetail?
Hi <Name>,
We noticed some drop in usage and want to help. Can we offer a 30-min session and a small usage credit to get back on track?
Best,
Maya
```

Priya (Enablement): I'll prepare a 30-min workshop template and a one-pager migration checklist.

Ethan (CS Ops): Creating play ticket now:
```
create_ticket --account AcmeRetail --play conserver --owner Maya --due 1793334550
```

Maya (CSM): Love it. Action items: Priya prep workshop by EOD tomorrow, Jasper draft concession terms, Ethan create ticket + schedule office hours, Nora send survey. I'll follow up with exec invite. :white_check_mark:

Jasper (RevOps): FYI I'll loop in legal if concession deviates from standard credits.

Maya (CSM): Thanks team — I'll update the customer thread and ping again after session.
